reportType: Local laboratory performance audit; not field Core Web Vitals

method.browserCache: Lighthouse default storage reset; separate cold browser per run
method.serverCache: Local PHP/database may be warm; no production CDN or LiteSpeed cache inferred
method.throttling: Lighthouse simulated mobile slow4G/4xCPU and desktop preset; exact settings saved per run
method.runOrder: Sequential mobile then desktop; no intentional parallel audits
method.thirdParty: Only the local installation is targeted. External requests, if any, are listed per run; active production widgets are not assumed.

interactions.method: Synthetic trusted touch interactions, local network, real CDP 4x CPU throttling, reduced motion; not field INP
